commentText: The sample size justification in the Methods section does not adequately describe the assumptions underlying the power calculation, in particular the expected hazard ratio and the accrual period.
responseText: We thank Reviewer 1 for this comment. The sample size justification has been expanded in the revised manuscript (Methods, paragraph 3, lines 187–194). The calculation assumed an expected hazard ratio of 0.65 with 80% power at a two-sided alpha of 0.05, a 24-month accrual period and 12 months of additional follow-up, requiring 512 PFS events.

commentText: Figure 2 (forest plot) lacks subgroup-level confidence intervals for the Asian patient subgroup. Given the differential PD-L1 expression patterns in this population, this omission is significant.
The discussion of the pembrolizumab monotherapy comparator arm is insufficient. The authors should address how the observed control-arm PFS compares with previously published first-line data.
Please clarify whether the independent data monitoring committee reviewed the primary analysis before database lock, and state the date of that review.
The abstract conclusion overstates the benefit. Please align the wording with the reported confidence interval.
responseText: We agree and have revised the abstract conclusion to state that the combination "significantly improved progression-free survival (HR 0.61; 95% CI 0.48–0.77)" rather than asserting a magnitude of benefit (Abstract, lines 41–44).

commentText: Grade ≥3 adverse event rates should be presented by system organ class, not only in aggregate.
responseText: A new supplementary table (Table S4) presents grade ≥3 treatment-emergent adverse events by system organ class for both arms, and the Results text now references it (Results, lines 302–308).

commentText: Please state whether any patients crossed over to the combination arm after progression.
responseText: No crossover was permitted by protocol. This is now stated explicitly in the Methods (lines 214–216) and reflected in the Discussion of overall survival interpretation.

commentText: The data availability statement is too restrictive for the journal's policy. Please revise to describe the specific mechanism by which de-identified data may be requested.
The introduction should cite the most recent TIGIT-directed combination data published in 2024.
responseText: Two 2024 references describing TIGIT-directed combination therapy have been added to the Introduction (references 8 and 9, lines 62–68).

commentText: Please confirm the trial registration number appears on the title page.
responseText: The trial registration number now appears on the title page and in the Methods (lines 176–177).

commentText: Please supply a marked-up manuscript showing all changes, together with a clean copy, and confirm that all authors have approved the revised version.
